verses.text: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.

footnotes.text: Bel and Nebo: Bel was another name for Marduk, the chief god of the Babylonians. Nebo was the son of Marduk and also an important god.
as … animals: One possible meaning for the difficult Hebrew text.

verses.text: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the LORD. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?
Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it.

footnotes.text: Now … mind: One possible meaning for the difficult Hebrew text.

verses.text: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
